name: SkinGuide MCP
description: Search skincare products by Baumann skin type, product category, and budget. Find the perfect products for your skin type among 16 different skin type profiles.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search skincare products by type, skin type, brand, budget, keyword, and ingredient. By default results come in the catalog's default order (lowest price first); pass sort to change it. Returns products with name, brand, price, link, image, and compatible skin types. The response also includes available_without_ingredient_filter when the ingredient filter is used.

IMPORTANT USAGE NOTES:
- If total=0, the filters were too narrow — retry with fewer filters (remove ingredient, remove budget, etc.).
- 'ingredient' requires an exact text match in the stored ingredient list. Many products have incomplete ingredient data, so ingredient searches often return 0. If ingredient returns 0, retry using keyword=<ingredient_name> instead (e.g. keyword="vitamin e").
- 'skinType' must be a 4-letter Baumann code such as OSPT, DSPW, ORNW — NOT natural language like "sensitive" or "oily skin".
- 'keyword' searches product names and tags and is a reliable fallback for ingredient concepts.
- When total=0 with an ingredient filter, check available_without_ingredient_filter to see how many products matched the other filters — if > 0, retry with keyword instead of ingredient.

'total' is the number of matching products across the whole catalog (all filters are applied server-side); 'returned' is how many are in this response.

brand.description: Filter by brand name (partial match, case-insensitive). E.g., 'CeraVe', 'La Roche', 'Neutrogena'.

skinType.description: 4-letter Baumann skin type code — must be one of: ORNT, ORNW, ORPT, ORPW, OSNT, OSNW, OSPT, OSPW, DRNT, DRNW, DRPT, DRPW, DSNT, DSNW, DSPT, DSPW. Do NOT use natural language like "sensitive" or "oily".

od.description: Skin oiliness: 'O' for Oily, 'D' for Dry

sr.description: Skin sensitivity: 'S' for Sensitive, 'R' for Resistant

pn.description: Skin pigmentation: 'P' for Pigmented (prone to dark spots), 'N' for Non-pigmented

wt.description: Skin aging: 'W' for Wrinkled (shows aging), 'T' for Tight (firm)

budget.description: Maximum price in dollars. Use 5, 10, 20, 50, or 100. Use 101 for products over $100.

keyword.description: Search keyword matched against product name and tags (case-insensitive). Use this as a fallback when ingredient returns 0 results. E.g., 'vitamin e', 'retinol', 'acne', 'anti-aging'.

ingredient.description: Filter by ingredient name — requires exact text match in the product's ingredient list. Many products have incomplete ingredient data. If this returns 0, check available_without_ingredient_filter and retry with keyword=<ingredient_name> instead.

country.description: Country code for the product market. Defaults to 'US' when omitted. Supported codes: US (United States), AE (United Arab Emirates). Aliases accepted: UAE/EMIRATES/DUBAI → AE, USA/AMERICA → US.

sort.description: Optional sort order. Omit for the fast default (lowest price first). 'rating-desc' is slow (about 10s or more) and only a few hundred products have ratings.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return. Defaults to 50.

tools.name: get_skin_type_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Baumann skin type (e.g., ORPW, DSNT). Returns the title, full name, short description, long description, characteristics, and routine description.

tools.name: list_skin_types
tools.description: List all 16 Baumann skin types with their titles, names, short descriptions, and long descriptions. Useful for understanding the skin type classification system.

tools.name: get_routine
tools.description: Get the skincare routine for a specific Baumann skin type. Returns the routine title, description, a link to the routine page, and step-by-step instructions including product type, action, and time of day (AM/PM). Can filter by gender and time of day.

gender.description: Filter by gender: 'male' or 'female'. Omit for all.

timeOfDay.description: Filter by time of day: 'AM' for morning, 'PM' for evening. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_brands
tools.description: Get the skincare brands in the SkinGuide product catalog. The full list has several thousand entries, so pass `query` to narrow it (case-insensitive substring).

query.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter brand names by, e.g. "cera".

tools.name: get_product_types
tools.description: Get a list of all available product categories in the SkinGuide database.

tools.name: get_test_questions
tools.description: Get all skin type test questions for first-time users. Returns questions grouped by skin dimension (O_D, S_R, P_N, W_T) with answer options and scores. Use this to guide users through the Baumann skin type assessment.

tools.name: submit_test_answers
tools.description: Submit all 15 answers for the Baumann skin type test and get the 4-letter skin type code (e.g. DSNT, ORPW). REQUIRES A SIGNED-IN SKINGUIDE ACCOUNT: the live API (POST /api/submitTestAnswers) only scores answers for an authenticated user (Firebase ID token) and saves the result to their profile. Without a token, send the user to https://skinguide.beauty to take the test.

answers.description: Array of answers, one per question. Each entry contains the questionId (string index) and the selected score value (number).

questionId.description: The question identifier returned by get_test_questions (zero-based index as string, e.g. '0', '1', '2').

value.description: The numeric score of the chosen answer option.

tools.name: get_product_reviews
tools.description: Get user reviews for a specific product. Returns rating, comment, reviewer skin type, and date. Use the product_id returned by search_products.

product_id.description: The product ID as returned by search_products.

sort.description: Sort order: 'recent' (newest first, default) or 'rating' (highest rated first).

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return (default 50, max 100).

tools.name: get_product_ingredients
tools.description: Get the ingredient list (INCI names) for a specific product. Use the product id returned by search_products. Call get_ingredient_info for an ingredient's functions and safety ratings. If an entry carries a `detail` object, it holds structured fields only, and `_data_credit` says they come from Incidecoder (INKEEDecoder); repeat that credit when presenting them.

product_id.description: The product ID as returned by search_products.

tools.name: get_ingredient_info
tools.description: Look up a cosmetic/skincare ingredient in the skinguide.beauty ingredient catalog. Returns structured fields only: name, slug, also-called names, what it does, functions, comedogenicity, irritancy, an editorial rating (our_take) and source_url. No prose description is included. Pass either the slug (kebab-case) or the ingredient name as it appears on product labels. These fields are sourced from Incidecoder (INKEEDecoder): when presenting them, credit Incidecoder with the source_url as `_data_credit` states. Do not present them as skinguide.beauty's own content.

name.description: The ingredient name as it appears on product labels, e.g. "Niacinamide" or "Hyaluronic Acid".

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Return the top N products of a given category structured for side-by-side comparison. Filters by skin type, country, and budget; default order is lowest price first; sortBy 'rating' (slow, about 10s, few products rated) or 'price'. Useful when the user asks to compare cleansers, moisturizers, sunscreens, etc.

skinType.description: 4-letter Baumann skin type code to filter the candidate pool.

country.description: Country code for the product market. Defaults to 'US' when omitted. Supported codes: US, AE. Aliases accepted: UAE/EMIRATES/DUBAI → AE, USA/AMERICA → US.

budget.description: Maximum price per product, in the country's local currency.

sortBy.description: Sort order for the comparison. Omit for the fast default (lowest price first). 'rating' is slow (about 10s) and few products are rated.

limit.description: How many products to return (2–5). Defaults to 3.

tools.name: build_routine
tools.description: Build a complete skincare routine for a Baumann skin type with product recommendations per step. Returns routine steps annotated with candidate products and a cost summary. Supports two budget modes: 'per-product' (each step is independently filtered to ≤ budget) and 'total' (greedy allocation across mandatory steps first, then optional, staying under the total budget).

budget.description: Budget cap in local currency. Interpretation depends on budgetMode.

budgetMode.description: How 'budget' is applied. 'per-product' caps each step individually (default). 'total' caps the sum across the routine and greedily allocates mandatory steps first.

country.description: Country code for the product market. Defaults to 'US' when omitted. Supported codes: US, AE. Aliases accepted: UAE/EMIRATES/DUBAI → AE, USA/AMERICA → US.

sortBy.description: Candidate sort order within each step. Omit for the fast default (lowest price first). 'rating' is slow (about 10s per step) and few products are rated.

gender.description: Restrict the routine to gendered steps. Omit to include all.

timeOfDay.description: 'AM' for morning routine, 'PM' for evening. Omit for both.

limit.description: How many candidate products to return per step (1–5). Defaults to 3.
